answer_1.quote: We investigate methodologies for effectively leveraging LLMs to generate synthetic data for AM... The QOS approach employs a structure-aware prompting technique that instructs an LLM to paraphrase existing training instances while strictly preserving their original annotation labels... The DOS approach... prompts an LLM to generate a new argumentative text by imitating an existing training instance.
answer_1.outputs: Synthetic argumentative texts with component spans, types, and relations

answer_2.quote: We use three micro F1 metrics adopted from previous work: F1 span for identifying argument component spans, F1 aci for further classifying their types, and F1 ari for detecting relations between them... To quantitatively measure the diversity of the synthetic data, we conduct an analysis of semantic distance... derived from the cosine similarity of their embeddings...
